title: A creator wants you on the team
scenario: A small creator you follow DMs saying they love your edits and want you in a paid “youth creator team.” They send a contract link that first asks you to connect your social account with full posting access.

answers.A: Ask for the contract as a PDF or document that does not require social-account access.
answers.B: Connect the account because the collaboration is about posting content anyway.
answers.C: Verify the creator through a public business contact and review any contract with a parent/guardian before granting account permissions.

explanation: Account permissions can hand over posting, messages or recovery access. A real collaboration can be discussed before giving technical control.
